title: Pulsar APX eRig Wax Atomizer
description:
These unique coil-less quartz heating chambers use the power of fast-heating quartz crystal to thoroughly and evenly heat wax concentrates.

These atomizers are made to function with the Pulsar APX eRig.

Coil-less quartz cup
Heats evenly
Functions with the Pulsar APX eRig

Includes 1* Atomizer
